name: Product Sequence / Index for Point of Screen
description: you can take full control over how products are displayed in your Point of Sale. Each product can be given a unique POS Sequence Number, ensuring that important or frequently sold items always appear exactly where you want them.
summary: This app will allow users to configure the sequence of products and based on that sequence product will be loaded to the Point of Sale screen. This way the sales team can decide which needs to be shown at first and which needs to be shown at last. The POS Product Sequence module is designed to give you full control over how products are displayed in your Odoo Point of Sale. By default, Odoo lists products without any specific order, which can make the POS screen cluttered and harder to use when dealing with many items. This app solves that problem by allowing you to assign a custom sequence number to each product, so you can decide exactly where it should appear in the POS interface. Once enabled from the POS settings, every product gains a Product Sequence field under the Point of Sale tab. You can assign a number like “1” for the first position, “2” for the second, and so on. Products with sequence numbers are shown in order, while those left at “0” are automatically pushed to the bottom. This ensures your best-selling or frequently used products always appear at the top, saving time and making checkout faster. name: POS Product Detail
description: This Odoo POS app allows cashiers to instantly view detailed product information directly from the order line with a single click on the info icon. It improves checkout efficiency, reduces errors, and provides an easy way to display product details without leaving the POS screen.
summary: The POS Product Details Feature for Odoo enhances the Point of Sale experience by allowing cashiers and sales staff to instantly view important product information directly within the POS interface. After enabling the feature from Settings a convenient info icon appears next to each product in the order line. By clicking this icon, users can access a detailed popup window displaying all essential product information without leaving the POS screen. By providing this data directly in the POS, the app helps staff answer customer queries faster, confirm product availability in real time, and make informed sales decisions without leaving the POS screen. This reduces operational delays, enhances transparency, and leads to a better checkout experience. The app is easy to configure, supports multiple POS sessions or stores, and integrates seamlessly with the existing Odoo POS workflow. It is ideal for businesses looking to improve their POS operations with quick product insights and a more efficient sales process. name: POS Order Type
description: The Order Type in Point of Sale module enhances POS by enabling businesses to classify and manage sales orders based on predefined order types such as Dine-In, Takeaway, Delivery, or Service.
summary: The Order Type in Point of Sale module is designed to enhance the functionality of Odoo’s POS system by introducing the ability to categorize and manage sales orders based on their type. Businesses such as restaurants, retail outlets, and service providers often need to distinguish between different sales flows like Dine-In, Takeaway, Delivery, or Service. This module provides a simple yet powerful solution to streamline that process. With this app, administrators can create and configure multiple order types directly from the backend. Once enabled for a POS session, cashiers and sales staff can conveniently select the appropriate order type using a dedicated Order Type button in the POS interface. The module ensures that the chosen order type is consistently applied throughout the sales process: it appears on the POS screen for quick reference, is included on printed customer receipts, and is stored in the backend order records. By improving clarity, reducing miscommunication, and offering better tracking, the Order Type in Point of Sale module helps businesses deliver a smoother and more reliable customer experience while strengthening internal operations.
